activity_overrides.reason: Athaulf's 410–415 Visigoth kingship remained mobile rather than capital-based. Reviewed chronology places the court/people in Italy through 411, in Gaul from 412 through 414, and in Hispania with Barcelona as the final base in 415. Timeline segments close only this exact Activity and do not convert the mobile Visigoths polity into a static leaf.
